en.xiaom_network_toggle_hint: Select a segment to preview every connected road or track, including branches, bridges and tunnels. Review costs, then confirm. Locked or rejected segments are skipped. Closing the construction menu resets this switch.
en.xiaom_network_inverse: Remove / unlock the selected feature (captured at the initial click).
en.xiaom_network_reverse: Reverse road lane directions (captured at the initial click).
en.xiaom_network_counts: Found %d · Planned %d · Already matching %d · Skipped %d · Failed %d
en.xiaom_network_estimate_hint: Estimate from individual segment checks. Each upgrade uses current engine costs; adjacent upgrades can change the total.
en.xiaom_network_details_hint: The window shows a sample of engine messages; technical failures are also written to the game log.
en.xiaom_network_status_ready: Preview ready. Confirm to start the upgrades.
en.xiaom_network_status_nothing: There are no eligible segments to upgrade. Review the counts and reasons below.
en.xiaom_network_status_verifying: Checking that this network is still unchanged…
en.xiaom_network_status_applying: Upgrading one segment at a time…
en.xiaom_network_status_complete: Finished. Completed upgrades remain in the world.
en.xiaom_network_status_cancelled: Cancelled remaining work. Completed upgrades remain in the world.
en.xiaom_network_status_cancelling: Waiting for the current upgrade, then stopping…
en.xiaom_network_status_target_changed: The tool, target or parameters changed. Click a segment to create a new preview.
en.xiaom_network_status_world_changed: The network changed after preview. Click a segment to scan it again.
en.xiaom_network_status_funds: Stopped because funds are insufficient for the next segment. Completed upgrades remain in the world.
en.xiaom_network_status_error: Stopped after an API error. Review the details or game log.
en.xiaom_network_reason_locked: Locked by a station, depot or construction
en.xiaom_network_reason_resource: Missing or incompatible template / electrification variant
en.xiaom_network_reason_changed: Segment changed or no longer exists
en.xiaom_network_reason_proposal: Engine could not create a replacement
en.xiaom_network_reason_geometry: Replacement would change topology or another segment
en.xiaom_network_reason_buildings: Replacement would remove a building or module
en.xiaom_network_reason_objects: Replacement would lose a stop, signal or waypoint

zh_CN.xiaom_network_toggle_hint: 点击一段路，预览经过全部岔路、桥梁和隧道的相连公路或铁路网络。查看费用后确认升级。建筑锁定或无法升级的路段跳过，关闭建造菜单后开关重置。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_inverse: 移除所选设施／解除锁定（按点击路段时的反向操作状态）。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reverse: 翻转公路车道方向（按点击路段时的反向操作状态）。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_counts: 发现 %d 段 · 计划升级 %d 段 · 已符合 %d 段 · 跳过 %d 段 · 失败 %d 段
zh_CN.xiaom_network_estimate_hint: 费用由逐段预检汇总，实际按引擎当前报价结算；相邻路段升级可能影响总价。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_progress: 已处理 %d / %d 段 · 成功 %d 段 · 已结算 %s
zh_CN.xiaom_network_details_hint: 窗口展示部分引擎提示；技术错误也会写入游戏日志。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_scanning: 正在查找全部相连路段……
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_checking: 正在检查升级方案与费用……
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_ready: 预览完成。确认后开始升级。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_nothing: 没有可升级的路段，请查看数量和跳过原因。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_verifying: 正在核对预览后路网是否变化……
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_complete: 处理完成，成功的升级已保留在地图中。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_cancelled: 已取消剩余任务，已完成的升级保留。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_cancelling: 等待当前路段返回结果后停止……
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_target_changed: 工具、目标或参数已变化，请重新点击路段生成预览。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_world_changed: 预览后路网发生变化，请重新点击路段扫描。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_funds: 余额不足以升级下一段，剩余任务已停止；已完成的升级保留。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_status_error: 因 API 错误停止，请查看详情或游戏日志。
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_locked: 由车站、车库或建筑锁定
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_resource: 模板或电气化变体缺失／不兼容
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_incompatible: 车道或边缘设施不兼容
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_proposal: 引擎未能生成替换方案
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_geometry: 替换会改变拓扑或其他路段
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_buildings: 替换会拆除建筑或模块
zh_CN.xiaom_network_reason_objects: 替换会丢失站点、信号或路径点
